title: symbolizer
text: Equations enough. symbolizer turns fitted models equations, assumptions, interpretations, teachable model stories. equatiomatic returns LaTeX string, symbolizer returns structured symbolic model can render equation, list assumptions, bridge R syntax mathematics, interpret coefficient natural scale, (later versions) compare two models structurally explain comparison means biologically. Built first two TMB sister packages — drmTMB gllvmTMB — extended across full GLMM ecosystem used ecology evolution: glmmTMB, brms, MCMCglmm, sdmTMB, lme4, base lm/glm.

title: symbolizer
code: library(symbolizer) library(drmTMB)  set.seed(1) n <- 200 temperature <- runif(n, 10, 25) dat <- data.frame(   body_mass   = rnorm(n, 30 + 0.4 * temperature, exp(0.5 + 0.1 * temperature)),   temperature = temperature )  fit <- drmTMB(   drm_formula(body_mass ~ temperature, sigma ~ temperature),   family = gaussian(),   data   = dat )  sym <- symbolize(   fit,   symbols = c(body_mass = "W_i", temperature = "T_i"),   units   = c(body_mass = "g",   temperature = "C"),   context = "avian body-size location-scale model" )  equations(sym) symbol_table(sym) assumption_table(sym) parameter_interpretation(sym) cat(as_latex(sym))

what: Build the term-grammar / model-matrix bridge for one submodel — extract_terms
title: Build the term-grammar / model-matrix bridge for one submodel — extract_terms
text: extract_terms() prerequisite every renderer. bridges R formula terms <-> model-matrix columns <-> biological symbols. Without layer, equations silently break factor contrasts, interactions, offsets, transformations. model-matrix column (plus offsets), returns one row giving term label, source variable, role classification, factor contrast level, transformation applied, biological symbol, coefficient symbol, ready--splice LaTeX fragment. Supported roles v0.1: intercept, predictor, factor_contrast, interaction, transformation, offset. Random-effect terms detected upstream removed extract_terms() runs v0.1.

title: Symbolizer capability registry — symbolizer_capabilities
text: Status words follow drmTMB's five-level vocabulary: Stable: routine path tests, diagnostics, reader-facing example. First slice: fitted tested, intentionally narrow. Opt-control: available hardening, general modelling guarantee. Planned reserved: public grammar may exist, symbolize() rejects . Unsupported blocked: use analysis syntax.
